_note: SPDC palette (20 Oct 2026): deep teal + fresh mint on clinical white, warm gold for calls to action, navy for text and the footer. Chosen to be clearly different from the other ClinicFlow247 sites in Tadepalli (blue/green). Gold is a BACKGROUND colour only: text on gold is always ctaInk (navy). Mint is decoration/tint only on light backgrounds; as text it is used only on navy (mintOnDark). Colours become CSS variables (src/lib/theme.ts) that feed the Tailwind theme and the ClinicFlow white-label theme tokens (npm run tenant). Run `npm run contrast` after any change. Status stays placeholder until the clinic supplies a logo whose colours may refine these.
